hero.title: Handmade church vestments and folk embroidery

pillars.title: Vestments
pillars.text: Chasubles, copes, dalmatics, albs and stoles in every liturgical colour. Each piece is made to measure, with the cut and embroidery agreed with the parish.

pillars.title: Cloths and embroidery
pillars.text: Altar cloths, baptismal cloths and Richelieu embroidery, alongside Slovenian folk embroidery for ceremonial and festive wear beyond the church year.

pillars.title: Restoration
pillars.text: Repair and restoration of older vestments, canopies and tabernacles — from relining and edging to transferring preserved embroidery onto new fabric.

home.title: Šiviljstvo Mitra — handmade church vestments and folk embroidery
home.description: Handmade church vestments and Slovenian folk embroidery. Chasubles, stoles, albs, altar cloths and banners made to order. Betka Golob s. p., Preserje pri Radomljah, Slovenia.

ponudba.title: Catalogue — Šiviljstvo Mitra
ponudba.description: Catalogue of finished work: chasubles and stoles in every liturgical colour, albs, altar cloths, baptismal cloths, folk and Richelieu embroidery, banners and restorations.
